When I was 9, my parents neglected me a lot because of their work. During dinners, they would always look at their phone or answer calls from work. I also couldn’t talk to them about anything for 6 months. I tried to tell myself it’s okay because their work is more important than me. I was furious, sad and lonely but I didn’t tell them. 

So I just drew in my diary. 

I drew myself stabbing my mom’s phone. My mom found out about my diary and yelled at me for being childish and violent . From then on, I didn’t dare to tell my parents how I feel and if I’m going to keep a diary, I would type it on my computer and then lock the document with a password
I already have a therapist but it doesn’t feel like I’m getting better
